messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — we need to lock the enterprise-compliance MVP for next sprint. Customers pushing for audit exports, BYOK, retention controls, and legal-hold. My proposed minimal scope:

- immutable audit export (S3 + checksum) + basic time/tenant/event-type index
- BYOK handshake flow (manual operator-assisted for v1)
- retention presets (30/90/365) with server-side enforcement + API
- legal-hold flag that overrides retention

Thoughts? :eyes: 

Tom (Eng): +1 on focusing on export and BYOK. Full-text search is a big lift. For a robust export pipeline + index we need ~3 devs for ~3 sprints if we include dedupe and search. If we limit queries to time/tenant/event-type we can shave ~3 weeks.

Maya (Security): We must include tamper-evidence and signed receipts for exports. BYOK: design must use envelope encryption and produce audit logs showing key usage (who/when). Also need test vectors for key rotation.

Jared (SRE): Reuse existing blobstore export infra where possible. Concern: cached logs & KV caches — retention enforcement needs to run in control plane and purge caches. Also we need export retry/backoff and alerts for stuck jobs.

Lina (Sales): Customers want CSV + parquet export, and an API for on-demand legal-hold (legal teams request immediate holds). Also proof-of-delivery (signed manifest + checksum) is a must for many contracts. BYOK is front-of-mind for >3 enterprise prospects.

Raj (Legal): Legal hold must supersede retention. We need a chain-of-custody metadata schema to accompany every export. Minimal schema: request_id, tenant_id, export_ts, signer, checksum, retention_state. Also need retention exception workflow for subpoenas.

Aisha: Proposal to finalize MVP scope:
- Include: export to S3 (CSV/parquet), signed manifest + checksum, basic index (time/tenant/type), BYOK handshake (manual ops to rotate keys; no automated rotation), retention presets with server-side enforcement, legal-hold override.
- Defer: full-text search, automated key rotation, SOC2 evidence generator (move to alpha limited release).

Tom (Eng): Confirming scope change. Cutting full-text search means index is append-only event index with time-range queries. Dev plan:
- task 1: export pipeline & manifest signer (owner: Tom)
- task 2: lightweight index service (owner: Tom)
- task 3: retention enforcement + control plane hooks (owner: Jared)
Estimate: 2 engineers x 6 weeks + 1 infra engineer for bucket policies.

Maya (Security): Acceptance criteria (must pass for sign-off):
1) Tamper-evident events (signed with service key)
2) Export integrity verification (manifest + checksum)
3) BYOK handshake docs + test plan (manual flow validated)
4) Retention enforcement validated on stored + cached data
5) Audit trail shows key access events for BYOK tenants

Jared (SRE): Operational SLOs to include in launch checklist:
- Export job success rate >= 99.9% over 7d window
- Export latency p95 < 5m for 1GB batches
- Alerts for >3 retry attempts / job
- Dashboard: export latency histogram, failed job count, retention purge rate

Tom (Eng): Blockers I see: bucket policies for dedicated customers (need infra quotas + IAM templates), signed-manifest key storage (where to keep signer keys), and export bandwidth limits. Action: infra to PR CloudFormation templates for bucket policy + IAM.

Maya (Security): For signer keys, use customer's KMS where BYOK enabled, otherwise platform KMS with HSM-backed key. Need threat model doc for signer key compromise.

Raj (Legal): Add legal-hold acceptance: "When legal-hold=true, retention must not delete until hold cleared and exports must include hold flag in manifest." Also require retention logs for audit (who set/cleared hold, timestamp).

Lina (Sales): Can we add customer validation window? Recommend we onboard 3 pilot customers (one finserv, one platform, one startup) to validate presets and BYOK handshake.

Aisha: Owners & next steps:
- Tom -> audit export pipeline + index (owner of PRs)
- Maya -> security acceptance criteria, BYOK design and threat model
- Jared -> infra for retention enforcement + SLOs
- Raj -> legal-hold schema + exception flow
- Lina -> recruit pilot customers & run validation sessions
- Aisha -> consolidate acceptance criteria and publish launch checklist

Quick tech note (from Tom):
```
retention_presets = {
  "short": 30,  # days
  "standard": 90,
  "long": 365
}
```

Aisha: Action items before EOD Friday:
- Tom: draft export pipeline RFC (link pls)
- Maya: BYOK handshake diagram + test plan
- Jared: CF template for bucket policy PR
- Raj: legal-hold schema doc
- Lina: list of 3 candidate pilots

Tom: I can have the RFC up by Thursday EOD. :thumbsup:

Maya: I'll circulate the BYOK diagram and threat model by Friday AM. :eyes: 

Jared: Starting bucket policy template today, will open PR tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder — sprint-planning kickoff in #eng-releases at 10:00am tomorrow.

Aisha: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after RFCs and diagrams. Meeting if needed. :rocket:
